units.zh: 梁書卷第十七 列傳第十一
units.en: Book of Liang, Volume 17, Biographies 11
units.literal: Book of Liang, Volume 17, Biographies 11

units.zh: 王珍國 馬仙琕 張齊
units.en: Wang Zhenguo; Ma Xianpin; Zhang Qi
units.literal: Wang Zhenguo; Ma Xianpin; Zhang Qi

units.zh: 王珍國字德重，沛國相人也。
units.en: Wang Zhenguo, styled Dezong, came from Xiang in Pei commandery.
units.literal: Wang Zhenguo, styled Dezong, was a native of Xiang in Pei commandery.

units.zh: 父廣之，齊世良將，官至散騎常侍、車騎將軍。
units.en: His father Guangzhi was a noted Qi general who rose to scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary and chariot-and-cavalry general.
units.literal: His father Guangzhi was a fine general of Qi, reaching scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary and chariot-and-cavalry general.

units.zh: 珍國起家冠軍行參軍，累遷虎賁中郎將、南譙太守，治有能名。
units.en: Zhenguo began as champion army acting staff officer, rose through tiger-guard commandant of the center and Nanqiao prefect, and won a name for able rule.
units.literal: Zhenguo began office as champion army acting staff officer, rose through tiger-guard commandant of the center and Nanqiao prefect, and was famed for capable governance.

units.zh: 時郡境苦饑，乃發米散財，以拯窮乏。
units.en: The commandery was in bitter famine; he opened granaries and scattered wealth to save the poor.
units.literal: At the time the commandery suffered bitter famine; he issued grain and scattered wealth to relieve the destitute.

units.zh: 齊高帝手敕云：「卿愛人治國，甚副吾意也。」
units.en: Qi Gaodi wrote by hand, "You love the people and govern the state—this suits my intent well."
units.literal: Qi Gaodi wrote by hand: "You love the people and govern the state well—this suits my intent very well."

units.zh: 永明初，遷桂陽內史，討捕盜賊，境內肅清。
units.en: At the start of Yongming he became Guiyang interior governor, hunted bandits, and pacified the territory.
units.literal: At the start of Yongming he was transferred to Guiyang interior governor, hunted down bandits and robbers, and the territory was pacified.

units.zh: 罷任還都，路經江州，刺史柳世隆臨渚餞別，見珍國還裝輕素，乃歎曰：「此真可謂良二千石也！」
units.en: When his term ended he returned to court; passing Jiangzhou, Inspector Liu Shilong came to the ford to see him off, saw his baggage light and plain, and sighed, "This is a true two-thousand-dan official!"
units.literal: When his term ended he returned to the capital; passing through Jiangzhou, Inspector Liu Shilong came to the ford to bid farewell, saw Zhenguo's return baggage light and plain, and sighed: "This truly may be called a fine two-thousand-dan official!"

units.zh: 還爲大司馬中兵參軍。
units.en: On return he was made grand marshal central army staff officer.
units.literal: On return he was made grand marshal central army staff officer.

units.zh: 武帝雅相知賞，每歎曰：「晚代將家子弟，有如珍國者少矣。」
units.en: Emperor Wu of Qi knew and prized him; he often sighed and said, "Among later generations of generals' houses, few sons are like Zhenguo."
units.literal: Emperor Wu of Qi greatly knew and appreciated him; he often sighed and said: "Among later-age generals' sons, few are like Zhenguo."

units.zh: 復出爲安成內史。
units.en: He went out again as Ancheng interior governor.
units.literal: He went out again as Ancheng interior governor.

units.zh: 入爲越騎校尉，冠軍長史、鐘離太守。
units.en: He entered as crossbow-and-horses commandant, champion chief of staff, and Zhongli prefect.
units.literal: He entered office as crossbow-and-horses commandant, champion chief of staff, and Zhongli prefect.

units.zh: 仍遷巴東、建平二郡太守。
units.en: He was then transferred to prefect of Badong and Jianping.
units.literal: He was then transferred to prefect of Ba and Ping commanderies.

units.zh: 還爲遊擊將軍，以父憂去職。
units.en: On return he was made raid general and left office for his father's mourning.
units.literal: On return he was made raid general and left office for his father's mourning.

units.zh: 建武末，魏軍圍司州，明帝使徐州刺史裴叔業攻拔渦陽，以爲聲援，起珍國爲輔國將軍，率兵助焉。
units.en: Late in Jianwu, Wei besieged Si province; Emperor Ming sent Xuzhou inspector Pei Shuye to take Guoyang as a diversion and raised Zhenguo to supporting-the-state general to reinforce him.
units.literal: Late in Jianwu, Wei forces besieged Si Province; Emperor Ming sent Xuzhou Inspector Pei Shuye to attack and capture Guoyang as a diversion, and raised Zhenguo to supporting-the-state general to lead troops in support.

units.zh: 魏將楊大眼大衆奄至，叔業懼，棄軍走，珍國率其衆殿，故不至大敗。
units.en: Wei general Yang Dayan's host suddenly arrived; Shuye in fear abandoned the army and fled; Zhenguo led the rearguard, so the defeat was not total.
units.literal: Wei general Yang Dayan's great host suddenly arrived; Shuye in fear abandoned the army and fled; Zhenguo led his men as rearguard, so they did not suffer great defeat.

units.zh: 永泰元年，會稽太守王敬則反，珍國又率衆距之。
units.en: In Yongtai year one, Kuaiji prefect Wang Jingze rebelled; Zhenguo again led troops against him.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongtai, Kuaiji prefect Wang Jingze rebelled; Zhenguo again led troops to resist.

units.zh: 敬則平，遷寧朔將軍、青、冀二州刺史，將軍如故。
units.en: When Jingze was pacified, he was made pacifying-the-north general and inspector of Qing and Ji, general as before.
units.literal: When Jingze was pacified, he was made pacifying-the-north general and inspector of Qing and Ji, general as before.

units.zh: 義師起，東昏召珍國以衆還京師，入頓建康城。
units.en: When the Righteous Army rose, Donghun summoned Zhenguo with his troops to the capital; he entered and garrisoned Jiankang.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army rose, Donghun summoned Zhenguo with his troops back to the capital; he entered and garrisoned Jiankang city.

units.zh: 義師至，使珍國出屯朱雀門，爲王茂軍所敗，乃入城。
units.en: When the Righteous Army arrived, Donghun sent Zhenguo to camp at Zhuque Gate; Wang Mao's army defeated him and he re-entered the city.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army arrived, Donghun had Zhenguo go out and camp at Zhuque Gate; he was defeated by Wang Mao's army and re-entered the city.

units.zh: 仍密遣郄纂奉明鏡獻誠於高祖，高祖斷金以報之。
units.en: He secretly sent Xi Zuan to present a bright mirror to Gaozu as pledge of loyalty; Gaozu broke gold in answer.
units.literal: He then secretly sent Xi Zuan to present a bright mirror as pledge of loyalty to Gaozu; Gaozu broke gold to answer him.

units.zh: 時城中咸思從義，莫敢先發，侍中、衛尉張稷都督衆軍，珍國潛結稷腹心張齊要稷，稷許之。
units.en: Everyone in the city wished to turn to the righteous cause, yet none dared move first; attendant Zhang Ji as Ministry of Guard general commanded the host; Zhenguo secretly won over Ji's confidant Zhang Qi to sway Ji, and Ji agreed.
units.literal: At the time everyone in the city wished to follow righteousness, yet none dared act first; Attendant Zhang Ji as Ministry of Guard general commanded all troops; Zhenguo secretly joined with Ji's trusted man Zhang Qi to win Ji over, and Ji agreed.

units.zh: 十二月丙寅旦，珍國引稷於衛尉府，勒兵入自雲龍門，卽東昏於內殿斬之，與稷會尚書僕射王亮等於西鐘下，使中書舍人裴長穆等奉東昏首歸高祖。
units.en: On the morning of day bingyin in the twelfth month, Zhenguo led Ji to the Ministry of Guard headquarters, mustered troops through Cloud Dragon Gate, and at once beheaded Donghun in the inner hall; with Ji he met right vice director Wang Liang and others below the western bell and had palace scribe Pei Changmu and others present Donghun's head to Gaozu.
units.literal: On the morning of day bingyin in the twelfth month, Zhenguo led Ji to the Ministry of Guard headquarters, mustered troops entering by Cloud Dragon Gate, and at once beheaded Donghun in the inner hall; with Ji he met Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others below the western bell, and had Palace Scribe-in-Ordinary Pei Changmu and others present Donghun's head to Gaozu.

units.zh: 以功授右衛將軍，辭不拜；
units.en: For merit he was appointed right guard general; he declined;
units.literal: For merit he was appointed right guard general; he declined and did not accept;

units.zh: 又授徐州刺史，固乞留京師。
units.en: Again appointed Xuzhou inspector; he firmly begged to stay in the capital.
units.literal: Again appointed Xuzhou inspector; he firmly begged to remain in the capital.

units.zh: 復賜金帛，珍國又固讓。
units.en: Again granted gold and silk; Zhenguo again firmly declined.
units.literal: Again granted gold and silk; Zhenguo again firmly declined.

units.zh: 敕答曰：「昔田子泰固辭絹穀。
units.en: An edict replied, "In old times Tian Zitai firmly declined silk and grain.
units.literal: Edict replied: "In old times Tian Zitai firmly declined silk and grain.

units.zh: 卿體國情深，良在可嘉。」
units.en: Your care for the state runs deep—truly praiseworthy."
units.literal: Your care for the state runs deep—truly praiseworthy."

units.zh: 後因侍宴，帝問曰：「卿明鏡尚存，昔金何在？」
units.en: Later at a feast the emperor asked, "Your bright mirror still exists—where is the gold of old?"
units.literal: Later at a feast the emperor asked: "Your bright mirror still exists—where is the gold of old?"

units.zh: 珍國答曰：「黃金謹在臣肘，不敢失墜。」
units.en: Zhenguo answered, "The gold is carefully at my elbow; I dare not let it fall."
units.literal: Zhenguo answered: "The gold is carefully at my elbow; I dare not let it fall."

units.zh: 復爲右衛將軍，加給事中，遷左衛將軍，加散騎常侍。
units.en: Again made right guard general with additional supervisory attendant; transferred to left guard general with additional scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary.
units.literal: Again made right guard general, with additional supervisory attendant; transferred to left guard general with additional scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary.

units.zh: 天監初，封灄陽縣侯，邑千戶。
units.en: At the start of Tianjian he was enfeoffed marquis of Zhenyang with a thousand households.
units.literal: At the start of Tianjian he was enfeoffed Marquis of Zhenyang with a thousand households.

units.zh: 除都官尚書，常侍如故。
units.en: Made director of the court for public works, attendant-in-ordinary as before.
units.literal: Made Director of the Court for Public Works, attendant-in-ordinary as before.

units.zh: 五年，魏任城王元澄寇鐘離，高祖遣珍國，因問討賊方略。
units.en: In year five, Wei's prince of Rencheng Yuan Cheng raided Zhongli; Gaozu sent Zhenguo and asked how to defeat the rebels.
units.literal: In year five, Wei's Prince of Rencheng Yuan Cheng raided Zhongli; Gaozu sent Zhenguo and asked the strategy for attacking the rebels.

units.zh: 珍國對曰：「臣常患魏衆少，不苦其多。」
units.en: Zhenguo replied, "Your subject always worries that Wei has too few troops, not that they have too many."
units.literal: Zhenguo replied: "Your subject always worries that Wei has too few troops, not that they have too many."

units.zh: 高祖壯其言，乃假節，與衆軍同討焉。
units.en: Gaozu admired his words, granted credentials, and sent him with the armies on the campaign.
units.literal: Gaozu admired his words and then granted credentials of office; he joined the armies in the campaign together.

units.zh: 魏軍退，班師。
units.en: Wei withdrew; the army returned in triumph.
units.literal: Wei forces withdrew; the army returned in triumph.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、都督梁秦二州諸軍事、征虜將軍、南秦梁二州刺史。
units.en: He went out bearer of staff, commander of Liang and Qin military affairs, campaign general who subdues barbarians, and inspector of Nan Qin and Liang.
units.literal: He went out as bearer of staff and credentials, commander of military affairs in Liang and Qin, campaign general who subdues barbarians, and inspector of Nan and Liang.

units.zh: 會梁州長史夏侯道遷以州降魏，珍國步道出魏興，將襲之，不果，遂留鎮焉。
units.en: When Liang's long chief of staff Xiahou Daoyuan surrendered the province to Wei, Zhenguo marched overland through Wei Xing to strike but failed and remained to garrison.
units.literal: When Liang's long chief of staff Xia Hou Daoyuan surrendered the province to Wei, Zhenguo marched by land through Wei Xing intending to strike, but did not succeed, and remained to garrison there.

units.zh: 以無功，累表請解，高祖弗許。
units.en: For lack of merit he repeatedly asked to resign; Gaozu would not allow it.
units.literal: For lack of merit he repeatedly memorialized to resign; Gaozu would not permit it.

units.zh: 改封宜陽縣侯，戶邑如前。
units.en: His enfeoffment was changed to marquis of Yiyang, households as before.
units.literal: His enfeoffment was changed to Marquis of Yiyang, fief households as before.

units.zh: 徵還爲員外散騎常侍、太子右衛率，加後軍。
units.en: Recalled as outer scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary and crown prince right guard leader, with additional rear army.
units.literal: Recalled to be outer scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary and crown prince right guard leader, with additional rear army.

units.zh: 頃之，復爲左衛將軍。
units.en: Before long, again left guard general.
units.literal: Before long, again left guard general.

units.zh: 九年，出爲使持節、都督湘州諸軍事、信武將軍、湘州刺史。
units.en: In year nine he went out bearer of staff, commander of Xiang military affairs, faithful martial general, and Xiang inspector.
units.literal: In year nine he went out as bearer of staff, commander of Xiang military affairs, faithful martial general, and Xiang inspector.

units.zh: 視事四年，徵還爲護軍將軍，遷通直散騎常侍、丹陽尹。
units.en: After four years in office he was recalled as protector general, then undisguised scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary and Danyang governor.
units.literal: After four years in office he was recalled as Protector General, transferred to undisguised scattered-cavalry attendant-in-ordinary and Danyang governor.

units.zh: 十四年，卒。
units.en: In year fourteen he died.
units.literal: In year fourteen he died.

units.zh: 詔贈車騎將軍，給鼓吹一部，賻錢十萬，布百匹。
units.en: An edict granted chariot-and-cavalry general, one set of martial music, ten thousand cash for the funeral, and a hundred bolts of cloth.
units.literal: Edict granted chariot-and-cavalry general, one set of martial music, funeral money ten thousand, and cloth one hundred bolts.

units.zh: 諡曰威。
units.en: Posthumous title: Wei.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Wei.

units.zh: 子僧度嗣。
units.en: His son Sengdu inherited.
units.literal: His son Sengdu inherited.

units.zh: 馬仙琕，字靈馥，扶風郿人也。
units.en: Ma Xianpin, styled Lingfu, came from Mei in Fufeng.
units.literal: Ma Xianpin, styled Lingfu, was a native of Mei in Fufeng.

units.zh: 父伯鸞，宋冠軍司馬。
units.en: His father Boluan was Song champion army acting chief of staff.
units.literal: His father Boluan was Song champion army acting chief of staff.

units.zh: 仙琕少以果敢聞，遭父憂，毀瘠過禮，負土成墳，手植松柏。
units.en: From youth Xianpin was known for daring; when his father died his mourning exceeded ritual—he carried earth for the mound and planted pines and cypresses himself.
units.literal: Xianpin from youth was known for daring and resolve; when his father died his grief-wasting exceeded ritual—he carried earth to make the mound and planted pines and cypresses with his own hands.

units.zh: 起家郢州主簿，遷武騎常侍，爲小將，隨齊安陸王蕭緬。
units.en: He began as Yezhou chief clerk, rose to martial-cavalry regular attendant, served as a junior officer, and followed Qi's prince of Anlu Xiao Mian.
units.literal: He began office as Yezhou chief clerk, transferred to martial-cavalry regular attendant, served as a junior officer, and followed Qi Prince of Anlu Xiao Mian.

units.zh: 緬卒，事明帝。
units.en: When Mian died, he served Emperor Ming.
units.literal: When Mian died, he served Emperor Ming.

units.zh: 永元中，蕭遙光、崔慧景亂，累有戰功，以勳至前將軍。
units.en: In Yongyuan, Xiao Yaoguang and Cui Huijing rebelled; he won repeated battle merit and rose to front general.
units.literal: In Yongyuan, Xiao Yaoguang and Cui Huijing rebelled; he repeatedly had battle merit and through merit rose to front general.

units.zh: 出爲龍驤將軍、南汝陰、譙二郡太守。
units.en: He went out as dragon-prancing general and prefect of Nan Ruyin and Qiao.
units.literal: He went out as dragon-prancing general and prefect of Nan Ruyin and Qiao.

units.zh: 會壽陽新陷，魏將王肅侵邊，仙琕力戰，以寡克衆，魏人甚憚之。
units.en: When Shouchun had newly fallen, Wei general Wang Su raided the border; Xianpin fought hard, the few overcame the many, and Wei greatly feared him.
units.literal: When Shouchun had newly fallen, Wei general Wang Su invaded the border; Xianpin fought hard, with the few overcame the many, and Wei men greatly feared him.

units.zh: 復以功遷寧朔將軍、豫州刺史。
units.en: Again through merit he was transferred to pacifying-the-north general and Yuzhou inspector.
units.literal: Again through merit he was transferred to pacifying-the-north general and Yuzhou inspector.

units.zh: 義師起，四方多回應，高祖使仙琕故人姚仲賓說之，仙琕於軍斬仲賓以徇。
units.en: When the Righteous Army rose, all quarters largely responded; Gaozu sent Xianpin's old friend Yao Zhongbin to win him over; Xianpin beheaded Zhongbin in camp to warn the host.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army rose, all quarters largely responded; Gaozu sent Xianpin's old friend Yao Zhongbin to persuade him; Xianpin in the army beheaded Zhongbin to display to the host.

units.zh: 義師至新林，仙琕猶持兵於江西，日鈔運漕，建康城陷，仙琕號哭經宿，乃解兵歸罪。
units.en: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, Xianpin still held arms west of the river, daily requisitioning transport grain; when Jiankang fell, he wept all night, then laid down arms and came to submit his guilt.
units.literal: When the Righteous Army reached Xinlin, Xianpin still held arms on the west of the river, daily requisitioning transport grain; when Jiankang fell, Xianpin wept and wailed a whole night, then laid down arms and came to submit his guilt.

units.zh: 高祖勞之曰：「射鉤斬袪，昔人弗忌。
units.en: Gaozu comforted him, saying, "Shooting the hook, cutting the sleeve—men of old did not resent such things.
units.literal: Gaozu comforted him, saying: "Shooting the hook, cutting the sleeve—men of old did not resent such.

units.zh: 卿勿以戮使斷運，苟自嫌絕也。」
units.en: Do not, because you killed the envoy and cut off supply, needlessly estrange yourself."
units.literal: Do not, because you killed the envoy and cut off supply, needlessly estrange yourself."

units.zh: 仙琕謝曰：「小人如失主犬，後主飼之，便復爲用。」
units.en: Xianpin apologized, "A petty man is like a stray dog without a master; when a new master feeds it, it serves again."
units.literal: Xianpin apologized: "A petty man is like a stray dog without a master; when a new master feeds it, it will serve again."

units.zh: 高祖笑而美之。
units.en: Gaozu laughed and praised him.
units.literal: Gaozu laughed and praised him.

units.zh: 俄而仙琕母卒，高祖知其貧，賻給甚厚。
units.en: Soon Xianpin's mother died; Gaozu knew he was poor and gave funeral gifts very generously.
units.literal: Soon Xianpin's mother died; Gaozu knew he was poor and gave funeral gifts very generously.

units.zh: 仙琕號泣，謂弟仲艾曰：「蒙大造之恩，未獲上報。
units.en: Xianpin wept and said to his younger brother Zhong'ai, "Having received great creating grace, I have not yet repaid it.
units.literal: Xianpin wept and said to his younger brother Zhong'ai: "Having received great creating grace, I have not yet repaid it.

units.zh: 今復荷殊澤，當與爾以心力自效耳。」
units.en: Now again receiving special favor—we shall repay with all our strength, you and I."
units.literal: Now again receiving special favor—we shall repay with all our strength, you and I."

units.zh: 天監四年，王師北討，仙琕每戰，勇冠三軍，當其沖者，莫不摧破。
units.en: In Tianjian year four, the royal army marched north; Xianpin in every battle was bravest in the three armies; whoever met his charge was shattered.
units.literal: In Tianjian year four, the royal army marched north; Xianpin in every battle was bravest in the three armies; whoever met his charge was not left unbroken.

units.zh: 與諸將論議，口未嘗言功。
units.en: When the generals discussed affairs, he never spoke of merit.
units.literal: When discussing with the generals, he never spoke of merit in his mouth.

units.zh: 人問其故，仙琕曰：「丈夫爲時所知，當進不求名，退不逃罪，乃平生願也。
units.en: When asked why, Xianpin said, "A man whom the age knows should advance without seeking fame and retreat without escaping punishment—that is his lifetime wish.
units.literal: When asked the reason, Xianpin said: "A man whom the age knows should advance without seeking fame and retreat without escaping punishment—that is his lifetime wish.

units.zh: 何功可論！」
units.en: What merit is there to discuss!"
units.literal: What merit is there to discuss!"

units.zh: 授輔國將軍、宋安、安蠻二郡太守，遷南義陽太守。
units.en: He was appointed supporting-the-state general and prefect of Song'an and Anman, then south Yiyang prefect.
units.literal: He was appointed supporting-the-state general and prefect of Song'an and Anman, transferred to south Yiyang prefect.

units.zh: 累破山蠻，郡境清謐。
units.en: He repeatedly broke the mountain barbarians; the commandery was quiet and orderly.
units.literal: He repeatedly broke the mountain barbarians; the commandery borders were quiet and orderly.

units.zh: 以功封浛洭縣伯，邑四百戶，仍遷都督司州諸軍事、司州刺史，輔國將軍如故。
units.en: For merit he was enfeoffed baron of Hansui with four hundred households, then commander of Si military affairs and Si inspector, supporting-the-state general as before.
units.literal: For merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Hansui with four hundred households, and was then transferred to commander of Si military affairs and Si inspector, supporting-the-state general as before.

units.zh: 俄進號貞威將軍。
units.en: Soon he was advanced to faithful martial general.
units.literal: Soon he was advanced in rank to faithful martial general.

units.zh: 魏豫州人白皁生殺其刺史琅邪王司馬慶曾，自號平北將軍，推鄉人胡遜爲刺史，以懸瓠來降。
units.en: A man of Wei Yuzhou, Bai Zaosheng, killed his inspector the prince of Langye Sima Qingzeng, styled himself pacifying-the-north general, and pushed his fellow villager Hu Xun as inspector to offer Xuanhu in surrender.
units.literal: A man of Wei Yuzhou, Bai Zaosheng, killed his inspector Prince of Langye Sima Qingzeng, styled himself pacifying-the-north general, and pushed his fellow villager Hu Xun as inspector to offer Xuanhu in surrender.

units.zh: 高祖使仙琕赴之，又遣直閤將軍武會超、馬廣率衆爲援。
units.en: Gaozu sent Xianpin; he also sent direct-palace general Wu Huichao and Ma Guang with troops as reinforcements.
units.literal: Gaozu sent Xianpin to go; he also sent direct-palace general Wu Huichao and Ma Guang with troops as reinforcements.

units.zh: 仙琕進頓楚王城，遣副將齊苟兒以兵二千助守懸瓠。
units.en: Xianpin advanced and encamped at Prince of Chu city and sent deputy general Qi Gou'er with two thousand men to help guard Xuanhu.
units.literal: Xianpin advanced and encamped at Prince of Chu city, sent Deputy General Qi Gou'er with two thousand troops to help guard Xuanhu.

units.zh: 魏中山王元英率衆十萬攻懸瓠，仙琕遣廣、會超等守三關。
units.en: Wei's prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying led a hundred thousand men against Xuanhu; Xianpin sent Guang, Huichao, and others to guard the three passes.
units.literal: Wei's Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying led a hundred thousand host to attack Xuanhu; Xianpin sent Guang, Huichao, and others to guard the three passes.

units.zh: 十二月，英破懸瓠，執齊苟兒，遂進攻馬廣，又破廣，生擒之，送雒陽。
units.en: In the twelfth month Ying took Xuanhu, seized Qi Gou'er, then attacked Ma Guang and defeated him, capturing him alive and sending him to Luoyang.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Ying captured Xuanhu, seized Qi Gou'er, then advanced to attack Ma Guang and again defeated Guang, capturing him alive and sending him to Luoyang.

units.zh: 仙琕不能救。
units.en: Xianpin could not rescue.
units.literal: Xianpin could not rescue.

units.zh: 會超等亦相次退散，魏軍遂進據三關。
units.en: Huichao and the others also withdrew in succession; Wei then advanced and held the three passes.
units.literal: Huichao and the others also in succession withdrew and dispersed; Wei forces then advanced to occupy the three passes.

units.zh: 仙琕坐徵還，爲雲騎將軍。
units.en: Xianpin was recalled for the failure and made cloud-cavalry general.
units.literal: Xianpin sat out the blame and was recalled, made cloud-cavalry general.

units.zh: 出爲仁威司馬，府主豫章王轉號雲麾，復爲司馬，加振遠將軍。
units.en: He went out as benevolent prestige staff officer; when the manor lord Prince of Yuzhang changed title to cloud-banner, he again became staff officer with additional shaking-the-distant general.
units.literal: He went out as benevolent prestige staff officer; when the lord of the manor Prince of Yuzhang changed title to cloud-banner, he again became staff officer with additional shaking-the-distant general.

units.zh: 十年，朐山民殺琅邪太守劉晣，以城降魏，詔假仙琕節，討之。
units.en: In year ten the people of Qushan killed Langye prefect Liu Xi and surrendered the city to Wei; an edict granted Xianpin credentials to attack.
units.literal: In year ten, the people of Qushan killed Langye prefect Liu Xi and offered the city in surrender to Wei; an edict granted Xianpin credentials to attack.

units.zh: 魏徐州刺史盧昶以衆十餘萬赴焉。
units.en: Wei Xuzhou inspector Lu Chang came with more than a hundred thousand men.
units.literal: Wei Xuzhou Inspector Lu Chang came with a host of more than a hundred thousand.

units.zh: 仙琕與戰，累破之，昶遁走。
units.en: Xianpin fought him, repeatedly defeated him, and Chang fled.
units.literal: Xianpin fought him, repeatedly defeating him; Chang fled away.

units.zh: 仙琕縱兵乘之，魏衆免者十一二，收其兵糧牛馬器械，不可勝數。
units.en: Xianpin loosed troops in pursuit; only one or two in ten of Wei's host escaped; grain, cattle, horses, and arms taken were beyond counting.
units.literal: Xianpin loosed troops to pursue; of Wei's host only one or two in ten escaped; grain, cattle, horses, and implements taken were beyond counting.

units.zh: 振旅還京師，遷太子左衛率，進爵爲侯，增邑六百戶。
units.en: The army returned in triumph; he was transferred crown prince left guard leader, advanced to marquis, fief increased by six hundred households.
units.literal: The army returned to the capital in triumph; he was transferred crown prince left guard leader, advanced in rank to marquis, fief increased by six hundred households.

units.zh: 十一年，遷持節、督豫北豫霍三州諸軍事、信武將軍、豫州刺史，領南汝陰太守。
units.en: In year eleven he was transferred bearer of staff, commander of Yu, north Yu, and Huo, faithful martial general and Yuzhou inspector, with concurrent Nan Ruyin prefect.
units.literal: In year eleven he was transferred bearer of staff, commander of Yu, north Yu, and Huo, faithful martial general and Yuzhou inspector, with concurrent Nan Ruyin prefect.

units.zh: 初，仙琕幼名仙婢，及長，以「婢」名不典，乃以「玉」代「女」，因成「琕」云。
units.en: At first Xianpin's childhood name was Xianbi; when grown, because "bi" as a name was not proper, he replaced the female radical with jade and made "Xianpin," it is said.
units.literal: At first Xianpin's childhood name was Xianbi; when grown, because "bi" as a name was not proper, he replaced "woman" with "jade," thus making "Xianpin," it is said.

units.zh: 自爲將及居州郡，能與士卒同勞逸。
units.en: As general and in commanderies and prefectures, he shared hardship and ease with officers and soldiers.
units.literal: From serving as general and holding commanderies and prefectures, he could share hardship and ease with officers and soldiers.

units.zh: 身衣不過布帛，所居無帷幕衾屏，行則飲食與廝養最下者同。
units.en: His clothing was no more than plain cloth and silk; his dwelling had no curtains, quilts, or screens; on the march he ate and drank with the lowest groom.
units.literal: His body clothing was no more than plain cloth and silk; where he dwelt there were no curtains, quilts, or screens; on the march his food and drink were the same as the lowest groom.

units.zh: 其在邊境，常單身潛入敵庭，伺知壁壘村落險要處所，故戰多克捷，士卒亦甘心爲之用，高祖雅愛仗之。
units.en: On the borders he often went alone in secret into enemy camps to learn walls, stockades, villages, and passes; hence he mostly won battles, and the soldiers were willing to die for him; Gaozu deeply loved and relied on him.
units.literal: On the borders he often went alone in secret into enemy camps to reconnoiter walls, stockades, villages, and strategic points; hence battles were mostly victorious, and the soldiers too were willing to die for him; Gaozu deeply loved and relied on him.

units.zh: 在州四年，卒。
units.en: After four years in the province he died.
units.literal: After four years in the province he died.

units.zh: 贈左衛將軍。
units.en: Granted left guard general.
units.literal: Granted left guard general.

units.zh: 諡曰剛。
units.en: Posthumous title: Gang.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Gang.

units.zh: 子巖夫嗣。
units.en: His son Yanfu inherited.
units.literal: His son Yanfu inherited.

units.zh: 張齊字子響，馮翊郡人。
units.en: Zhang Qi, styled Zixiang, was a man of Fengyi commandery.
units.literal: Zhang Qi, styled Zixiang, was a native of Fengyi commandery.

units.zh: 世居橫桑，或云橫桑人也。
units.en: His family had long lived at Hengsang; some say he was native there.
units.literal: His family had long dwelt at Hengsang; some say he was a man of Hengsang.

units.zh: 少有膽氣。
units.en: From youth he had courage and spirit.
units.literal: From youth he had daring and spirit.

units.zh: 初事荊府司馬垣歷生。
units.en: He first served Jing prefecture chief of staff Yuan Lisheng.
units.literal: At first he served Jing prefecture Chief of Staff Yuan Lisheng.

units.zh: 歷生酗酒，遇下嚴酷，不甚禮之。
units.en: Lisheng drank heavily and was harsh to subordinates; he showed Qi little courtesy.
units.literal: Lisheng was given to drink; he was harsh toward subordinates and did not treat Qi with much courtesy.

units.zh: 歷生罷官歸，吳郡張稷爲荊府司馬，齊復從之，稷甚相知重，以爲心腹，雖家居細事，皆以任焉。
units.en: When Lisheng left office, Zhang Ji of Wu became Jing chief of staff; Qi followed him again. Ji deeply trusted him as a confidant and even entrusted household matters to him.
units.literal: When Lisheng left office and returned home, Zhang Ji of Wu commandery became Jing prefecture Chief of Staff; Qi again followed him. Ji knew and valued him deeply, taking him as a trusted confidant—even household trifles were all entrusted to him.

units.zh: 齊盡心事稷，無所辭憚。
units.en: Qi served Ji wholeheartedly and shrank from nothing.
units.literal: Qi served Ji with his whole heart and shirked nothing.

units.zh: 隨稷歸京師。
units.en: He followed Ji back to the capital.
units.literal: He followed Ji back to the capital.

units.zh: 稷爲南兗州，又擢爲府中兵參軍，始委以軍旅。
units.en: When Ji took South Yanzhou, Qi was promoted to military participation officer on the staff and first put in charge of troops.
units.literal: When Ji was made South Yanzhou inspector, Qi was also promoted to Military Participation Officer on the prefecture staff and for the first time was entrusted with military affairs.

units.zh: 齊永元中，義師起，東昏徵稷歸，都督宮城諸軍事，居尚書省。
units.en: In Qi Yongyuan, the righteous army rose; Donghun recalled Ji, made him commander of palace-city forces, and lodged him in the Masters of Writing complex.
units.literal: In the Yongyuan era of Qi, the Righteous Army rose; Donghun summoned Ji back, made him Area Commander of all palace-city military affairs, and had him reside in the Masters of Writing complex.

units.zh: 義兵至，周邊漸急，齊日造王珍國，陰與定計。
units.en: As the righteous army drew near and the ring tightened, Qi visited Wang Zhenguo daily and secretly fixed their plan.
units.literal: When the righteous army arrived, the siege around them grew pressing; Qi went daily to Wang Zhenguo and secretly settled plans with him.

units.zh: 計定，夜引珍國就稷造膝，齊自執燭以成謀。
units.en: When the plan was set, at night he brought Zhenguo to Ji for a knee-to-knee counsel; Qi himself held the candle while they plotted.
units.literal: Once the plan was set, at night he led Zhenguo to Ji to join in deliberation knee to knee; Qi himself held the candle to complete the plot.

units.zh: 明旦，與稷、珍國卽東昏於內殿，齊手刃焉。
units.en: At dawn he, Ji, and Zhenguo seized Donghun in the inner hall; Qi himself killed him with his blade.
units.literal: At dawn the next day, together with Ji and Zhenguo, he seized Donghun in the inner hall; Qi himself struck him dead with his blade.

units.zh: 明年，高祖受禪，封齊安昌縣侯，邑五百戶，仍爲寧朔將軍、歷陽太守。
units.en: Next year Gaozu took the throne; Qi was made Marquis of Anchang with five hundred households, retaining pacification north general and Liyang administrator.
units.literal: The next year Gaozu received the abdication; Qi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Anchang county with a fief of five hundred households, and remained Pacification North General and Administrator of Liyang.

units.zh: 齊手不知書，目不識字，而在郡有清政，吏事甚脩。
units.en: Qi could neither write nor read, yet in office he ruled cleanly and managed affairs diligently.
units.literal: Qi did not know writing by hand and could not read characters by sight, yet in his commandery he had pure governance and handled official business very well.

units.zh: 天監二年，還爲虎賁中郎將。
units.en: In Tianjian year two he returned as tiger-fang central corps general.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianjian he was recalled and made Tiger-Fang Central Corps General.

units.zh: 未拜，遷天門太守，寧朔將軍如故。
units.en: Before taking post he was made Tianmen administrator, keeping pacification north general.
units.literal: Before he took the appointment he was transferred to Administrator of Tianmen, his Pacification North General title remaining as before.

units.zh: 四年，魏將王足寇巴、蜀，高祖以齊爲輔國將軍救蜀。
units.en: In year four Wei general Wang Zu invaded Ba and Shu; Gaozu made Qi assists-the-state general to relieve Shu.
units.literal: In the fourth year, Wei general Wang Zu invaded Ba and Shu; Gaozu made Qi Assists-the-State General to rescue Shu.

units.zh: 未至，足退走，齊進戍南安。
units.en: Before he arrived Zu had withdrawn; Qi advanced to hold Nan'an.
units.literal: Before he arrived, Zu withdrew; Qi advanced to garrison Nan'an.

units.zh: 七年秋，使齊置大劍、寒冢二戍，軍還益州。
units.en: In autumn of year seven he set garrisons at Dajian and Hanzong, then returned the army to Yizhou.
units.literal: In autumn of the seventh year Qi was ordered to set up two garrisons at Dajian and Hanzong; the army returned to Yizhou.

units.zh: 其年，遷武旅將軍、巴西太守，尋加征遠將軍。
units.en: That year he became martial array general and Baxi administrator, soon with added pacifies-the-distance general.
units.literal: That year he was transferred to Martial Array General and Administrator of Baxi, and soon was additionally made Pacifies-the-Distance General.

units.zh: 十年，郡人姚景和聚合蠻蜒，抄斷江路，攻破金井。
units.en: In year ten Yao Jinghe of the commandery rallied Man of Yan, cut the river route, and stormed Jinjing.
units.literal: In the tenth year, a man of the commandery, Yao Jinghe, gathered Man tribes of Yan and cut the river road, breaking Jinjing.

units.zh: 齊討景和於平昌，破之。
units.en: Qi attacked Jinghe at Pingchang and broke him.
units.literal: Qi attacked Jinghe at Pingchang and defeated him.

units.zh: 初，南鄭沒於魏，乃於益州西置南梁州。
units.en: Earlier Nanzheng had fallen to Wei, so South Liang province was set up west of Yizhou.
units.literal: Earlier Nanzheng had fallen to Wei; then South Liang province was established west of Yizhou.

units.zh: 州鎮草創，皆仰益州取足。
units.en: The new provincial seat depended wholly on Yizhou for supplies.
units.literal: The provincial seat was newly founded and depended wholly on Yizhou for supplies.

units.zh: 齊上夷獠義租，得米二十萬斛。
units.en: Qi reported righteous tribute from the Yi and Liao, gaining two hundred thousand hu of rice.
units.literal: Qi reported righteous tribute levies from Yi and Liao, obtaining two hundred thousand hu of rice.

units.zh: 又立臺傳，興冶鑄，以應贍南梁。
units.en: He also set relays and opened foundries to sustain South Liang.
units.literal: He also set up relay stations and opened smelting and casting to supply South Liang.

units.zh: 十一年，進假節、督益州外水諸軍。
units.en: In year eleven he gained acting credentials and command of Yizhou outer-water forces.
units.literal: In the eleventh year he was advanced to Acting Credentials and Area Commander of all Yizhou outer-water forces.

units.zh: 十二年，魏將傅豎眼寇南安，齊率衆距之，豎眼退走。
units.en: In year twelve Wei general Fu Shuyan attacked Nan'an; Qi resisted and Shuyan withdrew.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, Wei general Fu Shuyan invaded Nan'an; Qi led the host to resist him, and Shuyan withdrew.

units.zh: 十四年，遷信武將軍、巴西、梓潼二郡太守。
units.en: In year fourteen he became trusted martial general and administrator of Baxi and Zitong.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year he was transferred to Trusted Martial General and Administrator of the two commanderies Baxi and Zitong.

units.zh: 是歲，葭萌人任令宗因衆之患魏也，殺魏晉壽太守，以城歸款。
units.en: That year Ren Lingzong of Jiameng, as the people resented Wei, killed the Wei Jinshou administrator and surrendered the city.
units.literal: That year, Ren Lingzong of Jiameng, because the masses resented Wei, killed the Wei Administrator of Jinshou and offered the city in submission.

units.zh: 益州刺史鄱陽王遣齊帥衆三萬，督南梁州長史席宗範諸軍迎令宗。
units.en: The prince of Poyang as Yizhou inspector sent Qi with thirty thousand men, overseeing chief clerk Xi Zongfan and others to welcome Lingzong.
units.literal: Yizhou Inspector the Prince of Poyang sent Qi to command thirty thousand men, supervising South Liang Chief Clerk Xi Zongfan and all armies to welcome Lingzong.

units.zh: 十五年，魏東益州刺史元法僧遣子景隆來拒齊師，南安太守皇甫諶及宗範逆擊之，大破魏軍於葭萌，屠十餘城，魏將丘突、王穆等皆降。
units.en: In year fifteen Wei east Yizhou inspector Yuan Faseng sent his son Jinglong against Qi; Nan'an administrator Huangfu Chen and Zongfan counterattacked, crushing the Wei army at Jiameng, sacking more than ten cities; Wei generals Qiu Tu and Wang Mu among others surrendered.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year, Wei East Yizhou Inspector Yuan Faseng sent his son Jinglong to resist Qi's army; Nan'an Administrator Huangfu Chen and Zongfan counterattacked, smashing the Wei host at Jiameng, slaughtering more than ten cities; Wei generals Qiu Tu, Wang Mu, and others all surrendered.

units.zh: 而魏更增傅豎眼兵，復來拒戰，齊兵少不利，軍引還，於是葭萌復沒於魏。
units.en: Wei reinforced Fu Shuyan and fought again; with too few men Qi fared ill and withdrew, and Jiameng fell back to Wei.
units.literal: But Wei increased Fu Shuyan's troops and came again to resist; Qi's army was few and met with ill fortune, the army drew back, and so Jiameng again fell to Wei.

units.zh: 齊在益部累年，討擊蠻獠，身無寧歲。
units.en: Qi spent years in the Yi lands campaigning against Man and Liao; he had no peaceful year.
units.literal: Qi spent years in the Yi region, attacking and striking Man and Liao; he himself had no peaceful year.

units.zh: 其居軍中，能身親勞辱，與士卒同其勤苦。
units.en: In camp he shared labor and hardship with the troops.
units.literal: When he dwelt in the army he could personally share toil and hardship and suffer the same labor and pain as the soldiers.

units.zh: 自畫頓舍城壘，皆委曲得其便，調給衣糧資用，人人無所困乏。
units.en: He sketched encampments and walls to suit every need and rationed clothing and grain so none wanted for anything.
units.literal: He himself drew the plans for encampments and fortifications, all laid out for convenience in detail; he allocated clothing, grain, and supplies so that no man lacked what he needed.

units.zh: 旣爲物情所附，蠻獠亦不敢犯，是以威名行於庸、蜀。
units.en: Men attached to him and even Man and Liao dared not offend him; his fame ran through Yong and Shu.
units.literal: Once he had won men's hearts, even Man and Liao did not dare offend him; thus his martial renown spread through Yong and Shu.

units.zh: 巴西郡居益州之半，又當東道沖要，刺史經過，軍府遠涉，多所窮匱。
units.en: Baxi held half of Yizhou and lay on the vital eastern route; passing inspectors and distant army offices left many destitute.
units.literal: Baxi commandery occupied half of Yizhou and also lay on the vital eastern route; when inspectors passed through, army offices made long forays and many were impoverished.

units.zh: 齊沿路聚糧食，種蔬菜，行者皆取給焉。
units.en: Along the route Qi stockpiled grain and planted vegetables so travelers could be supplied.
units.literal: Along the road Qi gathered food stores and planted vegetables; all travelers could draw their needs there.

units.zh: 其能濟辦，多此類也。
units.en: His knack for getting things done was mostly of this kind.
units.literal: His ability to provide and complete matters was largely of this kind.

units.zh: 十七年，遷持節、都督南梁州諸軍事、智武將軍、南梁州刺史。
units.en: In year seventeen he became bearer of credentials, area commander of South Liang, sagacious martial general, and South Liang inspector.
units.literal: In the seventeenth year he was transferred to Bearer of Credentials, Area Commander of all South Liangzhou military affairs, Sagacious Martial General, and South Liangzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 普通四年，遷信武將軍、征西鄱陽王司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。
units.en: In Putong year four he became trusted martial general, western campaign staff officer to the prince of Poyang, and administrator of Xinxing and Yongning.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Putong he was transferred to Trusted Martial General, Chief Clerk to the Prince of Poyang in the Western Campaign, and Administrator of the two commanderies Xinxing and Yongning.

units.zh: 未發而卒，時年六十七。
units.en: Before departing he died, aged sixty-seven.
units.literal: Before he set out he died, aged sixty-seven.

units.zh: 追贈散騎常侍、右衛將軍。
units.en: Posthumously he was made regular attendant cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and right palace guard general.
units.literal: Posthumously he was made Regular Attendant Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Right Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 賻錢十萬，布百匹。
units.en: Funeral bounty was one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.
units.literal: Funeral bounty: one hundred thousand cash and one hundred bolts of cloth.

units.zh: 諡曰壯。
units.en: He was posthumously titled Zhuang (Stalwart).
units.literal: His posthumous title was Zhuang.

units.zh: 陳吏部尚書姚察曰：王珍國、申胄、徐元瑜、李居士，齊末咸爲列將，擁強兵，或面縛請罪，或斬關獻捷；
units.en: Chen minister of personnel Yao Cha said: Wang Zhenguo, Shen Gou, Xu Yuanyu, and Li Jushi—at the end of Qi all were ranked generals with strong armies; some bound themselves and pleaded guilt, some cut the passes and offered victory;
units.literal: Chen Minister of Personnel Yao Cha said: Wang Zhenguo, Shen Gou, Xu Yuanyu, and Li Jushi—at the end of Qi all were ranked generals holding strong armies; some bound themselves and begged mercy, some cut the passes and presented victory;

units.zh: 其能後服，馬仙琕而已。
units.en: Only Ma Xianpin could submit afterward.
units.literal: Those who could submit later were only Ma Xianpin.

units.zh: 仁義何常，蹈之則爲君子，信哉！
units.en: Benevolence and righteousness are not fixed—tread them and one becomes a gentleman. Truly!
units.literal: How constant are benevolence and righteousness? Tread them and one becomes a gentleman—truly so!

units.zh: 及其臨邊撫衆，雖李牧無以加矣。
units.en: When they guarded the border and led the troops, even Li Mu could not surpass them.
units.literal: As for when they faced the frontier and comforted the masses, even Li Mu could add nothing more.

units.zh: 張齊之政績，亦有異焉。
units.en: Zhang Qi's achievements in office were distinctive as well.
units.literal: Zhang Qi's administrative achievements also had their differences.

units.zh: 胄、元瑜、居士入梁事迹鮮，故不爲之傳。
units.en: Gou, Yuanyu, and Jushi left little record after entering Liang, so no biographies were written for them.
units.literal: Gou, Yuanyu, and Jushi had few deeds recorded after entering Liang, so biographies were not written for them.

units.zh: 後隨鄉人車騎將軍王廣之，廣之愛其勇，每夜臥下榻，征伐嘗自隨。
units.en: Later he followed his townsman chariot-and-cavalry general Wang Guangzhi, who loved his courage and let him sleep below his couch at night; on campaigns he always went along.
units.literal: Later he followed his townsman the chariot-and-cavalry general Wang Guangzhi, who loved his courage and let him sleep below his couch at night; on campaigns he always went along.

units.zh: 明帝遣廣之討子敬，廣之至歐陽，遣伯之先驅，因城開，獨入斬子敬。
units.en: The Ming Emperor sent Guangzhi to punish Zijing; at Ouyang Guangzhi sent Bozhi ahead, and when the gates opened Bozhi went in alone and beheaded Zijing.
units.literal: The Ming Emperor sent Guangzhi to punish Zijing; reaching Ouyang, Guangzhi sent Bozhi ahead, and when the gates opened Bozhi went in alone and beheaded Zijing.

units.zh: 脩城未畢，會魏將党法宗、傅豎眼率衆二萬，奄至城下。
units.en: Before the walls were done, Wei generals Dang Fazong and Fu Shuyan came with twenty thousand men and were suddenly at the gates.
units.literal: Before the walls were finished, Wei generals Dang Fazong and Fu Shuyan led twenty thousand men and suddenly reached the city.

units.zh: 王亮 張稷 王瑩
units.en: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying
units.literal: Wang Liang; Zhang Ji; Wang Ying

units.zh: 張稷字公喬，吳郡人也。
units.en: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a man of Wu commandery.
units.literal: Zhang Ji, styled Gongqiao, was a native of Wu commandery.

units.zh: 張稷因機制變，亦其時也。
units.en: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.
units.literal: Zhang Ji seized the moment to shift course—that too was its time.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，以功封江安縣侯，邑一千戶。
units.en: When Gaozu took the throne, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for merit, with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: When Gaozu accepted the abdication, Ji was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiang'an for his merit, with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 時魏寇壽春，以稷爲寧朔將軍、軍主，副尚書僕射沈文季鎮豫州。
units.en: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made pacifying-the-north general and army commander, assisting right vice director Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.
units.literal: At the time Wei raided Shouchun; Ji was made Pacifying the North General and army commander, assisting Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Wenji in guarding Yuzhou.

units.zh: 出爲使持節、散騎常侍、都督青、冀二州諸軍事、安北將軍、青、冀二州刺史。
units.en: He went out as bearer of credentials, cavalier attendant, area commander of Qing and Ji, Pacification North general, and inspector of Qing and Ji.
units.literal: He went out as Bearer of Credentials, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Area Commander of Qing and Ji military affairs, Pacification North General, and Inspector of Qing and Ji provinces.

units.zh: 父永，宋右光祿大夫。
units.en: His father Yong was Song right grand master of splendid happiness.
units.literal: His father Yong was Song Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

units.zh: 稷所生母遘疾歷時，稷始年十一，夜不解衣而養，永異之。
units.en: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he would not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.
units.literal: Ji's birth mother had long been ill; when Ji was eleven he did not unbind his clothes to nurse her—Yong marveled at this.

units.zh: 性疏率，朗悟有才略，與族兄充、融、卷等俱知名，時稱之曰：「充融卷稷，是爲四張。」
units.en: By nature he was careless and open, bright with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them, "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."
units.literal: By nature he was careless and open, bright and perceptive with talent and stratagem; with his kinsmen Chong, Rong, and Juan he was all famed—the age called them: "Chong, Rong, Juan, and Ji—that is the Four Zhangs."

units.zh: 齊永明中，爲剡縣令，略不視事，多爲山水遊。
units.en: In Qi's Yongming era he was Shan county magistrate, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.
units.literal: In Qi's Yongming era he was Governor of Shan County, scarcely overseeing affairs, often roaming mountains and waters.

units.zh: 梁臺建，爲散騎常侍、中書令。
units.en: When the Liang court was set up he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and director of the secretariat.
units.literal: When the Liang regime was established he was made Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 會賊唐㝢之作亂，稷率厲縣人，保全縣境。
units.en: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.
units.literal: When the bandit Tang Yuzhi rebelled, Ji led and encouraged the county people and preserved the county territory.

units.zh: 尋徵還，爲持節、輔國將軍、都督北徐州諸軍事、北徐州刺史。
units.en: Soon recalled, he became bearer of credentials, General Who Assists the State, area commander of North Xuzhou, and North Xuzhou inspector.
units.literal: Soon he was recalled and made Bearer of Credentials, General Who Assists the State, Area Commander of all North Xuzhou military affairs, and North Xuzhou Inspector.

units.zh: 北徐州刺史王珍國就稷謀之，乃使直閤張齊害東昏于含德殿。
units.en: North Xuzhou inspector Wang Zhenguo plotted with Ji; Ji had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.
units.literal: North Xuzhou Inspector Wang Zhenguo consulted with Ji; Ji then had Direct Attendant Zhang Qi kill Donghun in Hede Hall.

units.zh: 又爲侍中、國子祭酒，領驍騎將軍，遷護軍將軍、揚州大中正，以事免。
units.en: He again became attendant within and chancellor of the National University, with concurrent rapid cavalry general; he became protector general and Yangzhou chief rectifier, then was dismissed over an affair.
units.literal: He was again made Attendant Within and Chancellor of the National University, with concurrent Rapid Cavalry General; he was transferred to Protector General and Yangzhou Chief Rectifier, then dismissed over an affair.

units.zh: 尋爲度支尚書、前將軍、太子右衛率，又以公事免。
units.en: Soon he became minister of revenue, front general, and right crown prince palace guard commander, then was again dismissed over official business.
units.literal: Soon he was made Minister of Revenue, Front General, and Right Crown Prince Palace Guard Commander, then again dismissed over an official matter.

units.zh: 州人徐道角等夜襲州城，害稷，時年六十三。
units.en: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others attacked the seat by night and killed Ji, aged sixty-three.
units.literal: Provincial men Xu Daojiao and others night-attacked the provincial seat and killed Ji; he was sixty-three.

units.zh: 有司奏削爵土。
units.en: The responsible office memorialized to strip his fief and lands.
units.literal: The responsible office memorialized to strip his enfeoffment and lands.

units.zh: 稷兼衛尉，副王瑩都督城內諸軍事。
units.en: Ji held the concurrent guard commandancy and assisted Wang Ying in commanding the city's forces.
units.literal: Ji held the concurrent commandantship and assisted Wang Ying in commanding all military affairs within the city.

units.zh: 稷召尚書右僕射王亮等列坐殿前西鐘下，謂曰：「昔桀有昏德，鼎遷于殷；
units.en: Ji summoned Right Vice Director Wang Liang and others to sit before the western bell in the hall and said, "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;
units.literal: Ji summoned Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Wang Liang and others to sit in a row before the western bell in the hall and said: "Of old Jie had dark virtue, and the tripod moved to Yin;

units.zh: 商紂暴虐，鼎遷于周。
units.en: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.
units.literal: Shang's Zhou was violent and cruel, and the tripod moved to Zhou.

units.zh: 今獨夫自絕于天，四海已歸聖主，斯實微子去殷之時，項伯歸漢之日，可不勉哉！」
units.en: Now the tyrant has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"
units.literal: Now the lone man has cut himself off from Heaven; the four seas already belong to the sage lord—this is truly the time of Weizi leaving Yin, Xiang Bo returning to Han. You must exert yourselves!"

units.zh: 稷性烈亮，善與人交。
units.en: Ji was fierce and bright, and good at friendship.
units.literal: Ji's nature was fierce and bright, and he was good at making friends.

units.zh: 歷官無蓄聚，俸祿皆頒之親故，家無餘財。
units.en: He never hoarded in office; he gave his salary to kin and friends, and his house held no surplus.
units.literal: In office he never accumulated wealth; his salary he always distributed to kin and friends, and his house had no surplus.

units.zh: 永元末，徵爲侍中，宿衛宮城。
units.en: At the end of Yongyuan he was summoned as attendant within and guarded the palace city.
units.literal: At the end of the Yongyuan era he was summoned as Attendant Within and guarded the palace city.

units.zh: 會魏軍退，仍出爲散騎常侍、將軍，吳興太守，秩中二千石。
units.en: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as cavalier attendant and general, Wuxing administrator, at salary rank two thousand dan.
units.literal: When the Wei army withdrew he went out as Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and General, Wuxing Administrator, with salary rank at two thousand dan.

units.zh: 武陵王曅爲護軍，轉護軍司馬，尋爲本州治中。
units.en: When the prince of Wuling was guard general, Ji was transferred to guard general staff officer, soon made chief administrator of his native province.
units.literal: When Prince of Wuling Ye was Guard General, Ji was transferred to Guard General Staff Officer, soon made Chief Administrator of his native province.

units.zh: 明帝領牧，仍爲別駕。
units.en: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as vice governor.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming held the governorship, Ji remained as Vice Governor.

units.zh: 魏衆稱百萬，圍城累日，時經略處分，文季悉委稷焉。
units.en: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.
units.literal: Wei forces were said to number a million and besieged the city for many days; all planning and disposition Wenji wholly entrusted to Ji.

units.zh: 時雍州刺史曹虎度樊城岸，以稷知州事。
units.en: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was put in charge of provincial affairs.
units.literal: At the time Cao Hu, Inspector of Yong Province, crossed to the Fancheng bank, and Ji was made acting administrator of the province.

units.zh: 魏師退，稷還荊州，就拜黃門侍郎，復爲司馬、新興、永寧二郡太守。
units.en: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing province and was at once appointed yellow gate gentleman, again made staff officer and governor of Xinxing and Yongning.
units.literal: When Wei forces withdrew, Ji returned to Jing Province and was at once appointed Yellow Gate Gentleman, again made Staff Officer and Governor of both Xinxing and Yongning commanderies.

units.zh: 乃遣國子博士范雲、舍人裴長穆等使石頭城詣高祖，高祖以稷爲侍中、左衛將軍。
units.en: Then he sent National University erudite Fan Yun, attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to see Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji attendant within and left palace guard general.
units.literal: Then he sent National University Erudite Fan Yun, Attendant Pei Changmu, and others to Stone City to present themselves to Gaozu; Gaozu made Ji Attendant Within and Left Palace Guard General.

units.zh: 高祖總百揆，遷大司馬左司馬。
units.en: When Gaozu took charge of all affairs, Ji became the grand marshal's left staff officer.
units.literal: When Gaozu oversaw all state affairs, Ji was transferred to Left Staff Officer of the Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 輿駕將欲如稷宅，以盛暑，留幸僕射省，舊臨幸供具皆酬太官饌直，帝以稷清貧，手詔不受。
units.en: The emperor was about to visit Ji's house; in the intense heat he stayed at the vice director's office instead. Old custom reimbursed visit supplies from the Grand Provisioner; because Ji was poor, the emperor personally issued an edict that he accept nothing.
units.literal: The imperial carriage was about to visit Ji's house; because of the intense heat the Emperor stayed instead at the Vice Director's office. By old custom items for an imperial visit were reimbursed from the Grand Provisioner's feast allowance; because Ji was pure and poor, the Emperor personally issued an edict that he should not accept them.

units.zh: 會魏寇朐山，詔稷權頓六里，都督衆軍。
units.en: When Wei invaded Qushan, Ji was ordered to hold Liuli temporarily and command all armies.
units.literal: When Wei invaded Qushan, an edict ordered Ji to station temporarily at Liuli and command all armies.

units.zh: 且稷寬弛無防，僚吏頗侵漁之。
units.en: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often preyed on the province.
units.literal: moreover Ji was lax and undefended, and his staff often encroached and fleeced.

units.zh: 初去吳興郡，以僕射徵，道由吳鄉，候稷者滿水陸。
units.en: When he first left Wuxing and was summoned as vice director, his route passed Wu country; those waiting for Ji filled land and water.
units.literal: When he first left Wuxing commandery and was summoned as Vice Director, his route passed his Wu homeland; those waiting to see Ji filled the waterways and roads.

units.zh: 稷單裝徑還京師，人莫之識，其率素如此。
units.en: Ji returned to the capital alone with plain baggage; no one knew him—such was his austerity.
units.literal: Ji returned to the capital alone with simple baggage; no one recognized him—such was his plain simplicity.

units.zh: 稷長女楚瑗，適會稽孔氏，無子歸宗。
units.en: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married the Kong clan of Kuaiji; childless, she returned to her clan.
units.literal: Ji's eldest daughter Chu Yuan married into the Kong clan of Kuaiji; having no son, she returned to her clan.

units.zh: 至稷見害，女以身蔽刃，先父卒。
units.en: When Ji was killed, his daughter shielded him with her body and died before her father.
units.literal: When Ji was killed, his daughter used her body to shield the blade and died before her father.

units.zh: 稷子嵊，別有傳。
units.en: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.
units.literal: Ji's son Song has a separate biography.

units.zh: 卷字令遠，稷從兄也。
units.en: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.
units.literal: Juan, styled Lingyuan, was Ji's cousin.

units.zh: 俄而太尉陳顯達、護軍將軍崔慧景頻逼京師，民心遑駭，未有所定，西土人謀之於叡。
units.en: Soon Chen Xianda and Cui Huijing harried the capital repeatedly; fear ran wild and the west turned to Rui for a plan.
units.literal: Before long Grand Marshal Chen Xianda and Protector of the Army Cui Huijing pressed the capital again and again; the people's hearts were frantic and nothing was settled, and the men of the western lands looked to Rui for counsel.

units.zh: 崔頗更事，懦而不武。
units.en: Cui has weathered many storms, yet he is soft and no soldier.
units.literal: Cui has seen much, but he is timid and no warrior.

units.zh: 其取赤族也，宜哉！
units.en: They deserve the extinction of their houses—of course they do!
units.literal: That their clans should be wiped to the last man is only fitting!

units.zh: 永元二年，裴叔業據豫州反，授持節、征虜將軍、督豫州諸軍事、豫州刺史，領歷陽南譙二郡太守，討叔業。
units.en: In the second year of Yongyuan, Pei Shuye rebelled while holding Yuzhou. Yi received the staff of authority as General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, Commander-in-Chief of Yuzhou, and Governor of Yuzhou, and concurrently governed Liyang and Nanqiao, to suppress Shuye.
units.literal: In the second year of Yongyuan, Pei Shuye held Yuzhou in rebellion; Yi was given the staff of authority, the title General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, command of all military affairs of Yuzhou, and the governorship of Yuzhou, and was made concurrent governor of Liyang and Nanqiao, to campaign against Shuye.

units.zh: 叔業懼，降于魏。
units.en: Shuye, in fear, surrendered to the Wei.
units.literal: Shuye was afraid and surrendered to Wei.

units.zh: 高祖率衆先登賢首山，魏將王肅、劉昶來戰，茂從高祖拒之，大破肅等。
units.en: Gaozu led the army up Xianshou Mountain first; when Wei generals Wang Su and Liu Chang attacked, Mao followed Gaozu and routed them.
units.literal: Gaozu led the host first to mount Xianshou; Wei generals Wang Su and Liu Chang came to give battle, and Mao followed Gaozu to resist them, greatly defeating Su and the rest.

units.zh: 賾與河南元善、河東柳䛒、太原王劭、吳興姚察、琅琊諸葛潁、信都劉焯、河間劉炫相善，每因休假，清談竟日。
units.en: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.
units.literal: Ze was on good terms with Yuan Shan of Henan, Liu Bi of Hedong, Wang Shao of Taiyuan, Yao Cha of Wuxing, Zhuge Ying of Langya, Liu Zhuo of Xindu, and Liu Xuan of Hejian; on holidays they would converse in pure talk all day.

units.zh: 隨道恭至義陽，會中山王英平義陽，獲焉。
units.en: He followed Daogong to Yiyang, and when Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pacified Yiyang he was taken captive.
units.literal: He followed Daogong to Yiyang; when Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying pacified Yiyang he was taken captive.

units.zh: 英亡，亮奔赴，盡其哀慟。
units.en: When Yuan Ying died, Liang rushed to the funeral and mourned with the deepest grief.
units.literal: When Yuan Ying died Liang rushed to the funeral and mourned with the utmost grief.

units.zh: 英素聞其名，以禮待接。
units.en: Yuan Ying had long heard his name and received him with courtesy.
units.literal: Yuan Ying had long heard his name and received him with courtesy.

units.zh: 亮性清靜，後隱居嵩山，感英之德，以時展覲。
units.en: Liang's nature was pure and quiet; later he withdrew to Mount Song, moved by Yuan Ying's virtue, and from time to time paid him respectful visits.
units.literal: Liang's nature was pure and quiet; later he secluded himself on Mount Song, moved by Yuan Ying's virtue, and from time to time paid respectful visits.

units.zh: 解褐梁豫章王法曹參軍。
units.en: His first post was law officer on the staff of Liang's Prince of Yuzhang.
units.literal: He doffed the commoner's garb as law officer in the establishment of Liang's Prince of Yuzhang.

units.zh: 又嘗侍座，高祖曰：「徐元瑜違命嶺南，《周書》罪不相及，朕已宥其諸子，何如？」
units.en: Another time at court Gaozu said, "Xu Yuanyu rebelled in Lingnan. The Book of Zhou says punishment does not chain to kin—I have pardoned his sons. What say you?"
units.literal: On another occasion, while attending him, Gaozu said: "Xu Yuanyu defied orders in Lingnan—the Book of Zhou says crimes do not reach kin. I have already pardoned his sons. What do you think?"

units.zh: 會司州刺史馬仙琕北伐還軍，爲魏人所躡，三關擾動，詔叡督衆軍援焉。
units.en: Ma Xianbi of Sizhou marched north and was chased home by Wei; the Three Passes trembled, and Rui was ordered to command the rescue.
units.literal: When Sizhou Inspector Ma Xianbi marched north and returned, Wei pursued him; the Three Passes were shaken, and an edict made Rui commander of the relief armies.

units.zh: 是時元英復追仙琕，將復邵陽之恥，聞叡至，乃退。
units.en: Yuan Ying chased Xianbi again to avenge Shaoyang; hearing Rui had arrived, he retreated.
units.literal: At that time Yuan Ying again pursued Xianbi, meaning to wash away the shame of Shaoyang; when he heard Rui had come, he withdrew.

units.zh: 五年，魏中山王元英寇北徐州，圍刺史昌義之於鐘離，衆號百萬，連城四十餘。
units.en: In year 5 Yuan Ying, prince of Zhongshan, struck North Xuzhou and penned Chang Yizhi at Zhongli—"a million" men, forty-odd camps chained together.
units.literal: In the fifth year Wei's Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying raided North Xuzhou and besieged Inspector Chang Yizhi at Zhongli; they claimed a million men and more than forty linked camps.

units.zh: 七年，遷左衛將軍，俄爲安西長史、南郡太守，秩中二千石。
units.en: In year 7 he became left guard general, then chief clerk of Anxi and administrator of Nanjun at two-thousand-dan rank.
units.literal: In the seventh year he was made Left Guard General, then soon Anxi Chief Clerk and Administrator of Nanjun at the salary of two thousand dan.
